title: How to Reserve a Spot for an Event
content:
If a user asks how to reserve an event:

- Guide them to the CultPass app
- Instruct them to browse the experience catalog and tap 'Reserve'
- If it's a premium or limited event, check if reservation confirmation is required via email
- Remind them to arrive at least 15 minutes early with their QR code visible

**Suggested phrasing:**
"You can reserve an experience by opening the CultPass app, selecting your desired event, and tapping 'Reserve'. Be sure to arrive 15 minutes early with your QR code ready."

title: What's Included in a CultPass Subscription
content:
Each user is entitled to 4 cultural experiences per month, which may include:
- Art exhibitions
- Museum entries
- Music concerts
- Film screenings and more

Some premium experiences may require an additional fee (visible in the app).

**Suggested phrasing:**
"Your CultPass subscription includes 4 curated experiences each month. You can choose from museums, concerts, film events and more. Premium events may have an extra cost, which is shown during reservation."

title: How to Cancel or Pause a Subscription
content:
Users can manage their subscription via the app > 'My Account' > 'Manage Plan'.

- Cancel: Effective at the end of the billing cycle
- Pause: Preserves user data, resumes automatically when reactivated
- Do NOT offer refunds unless approved by support lead

**Suggested phrasing:**
"You can cancel or pause your subscription at any time via the 'My Account' section in the CultPass app. Cancelation takes effect at the end of your billing cycle."

title: How to Handle Login Issues?
content:
Most login issues are resolved with password reset:

- Ask the user to tap 'Forgot Password' on the login screen
- Ensure they are using the correct registered email
- If they did not receive the reset email, check spam folder or retry after 10 minutes
- For persistent login issues, escalate to human support

**Suggested phrasing:**
"Try tapping 'Forgot Password' on the login screen. Make sure you're using the email associated with your account. If the email doesn't arrive, check spam or try again in a few minutes."

title: How to Change or Cancel a Reservation
content:
If a user wants to change or cancel an existing reservation:

- Guide them to 'My Reservations' in the CultPass app
- Cancellations made at least 24 hours before the event free up the spot without penalty
- Cancellations made less than 24 hours before may count as a used experience
- To change a reservation, cancel the current one first, then rebook a new time/event if available

**Suggested phrasing:**
"You can cancel or change your reservation from 'My Reservations' in the app. Canceling at least 24 hours in advance won't count against your monthly experiences."

title: How to Handle No-Shows or Missed Reservations
content:
If a user missed a reserved event:

- Explain that missed reservations count toward the monthly usage and are not automatically refunded
- Check if the event had a cancellation window (usually up to 24 hours before) that was missed
- If the user has a valid exceptional reason (illness, emergency), escalate to support lead for possible manual credit
- Encourage the user to cancel in advance next time to free the spot for others

**Suggested phrasing:**
"Since this reservation wasn't canceled in advance, it counts toward your monthly experiences. If you had an emergency, I can escalate this to our support team for review."
tags: no-show, missed reservation, cancellation window, escalation

title: What to Do if the QR Code Doesn't Work
content:
If a user reports their QR code is missing or not scanning at the venue:

- Ask them to refresh the app or check their internet connection
- Confirm they are viewing the correct reservation under 'My Reservations'
- Suggest lowering screen brightness glare or cleaning the screen for scanning issues
- If the code still fails, advise them to show their reservation confirmation email and ID to venue staff as a backup
- For persistent app issues, escalate to human support

**Suggested phrasing:**
"If your QR code won't scan, try refreshing the app or checking your connection. As a backup, show the venue staff your confirmation email along with a photo ID."
tags: qr code, check-in, venue, technical issue

title: How to Upgrade or Downgrade a Subscription Plan
content:
If a user wants to change their subscription tier:

- Direct them to 'My Account' > 'Manage Plan' > 'Change Plan'
- Upgrades take effect immediately, with prorated charges applied
- Downgrades take effect at the start of the next billing cycle
- Remind users that downgrading may reduce the number of monthly experiences included

**Suggested phrasing:**
"You can upgrade or downgrade your plan under 'Manage Plan' in the app. Upgrades apply right away, while downgrades take effect next billing cycle."

title: How to Handle Failed or Declined Payments
content:
If a user's payment fails:

- Ask them to verify their card details and available balance/credit limit
- Suggest updating the payment method under 'My Account' > 'Payment Methods'
- Inform them that access may be restricted after repeated failed attempts until payment is resolved
- Do NOT manually extend access without support lead approval

**Suggested phrasing:**
"It looks like your last payment didn't go through. Please check your card details or update your payment method in 'My Account'. Your access will resume once payment is confirmed."
tags: payment, billing, declined card, account access

title: What Happens to Unused Monthly Experiences
content:
If a user asks about unused reservations at the end of the month:

- Explain that unused experiences do NOT roll over to the next month
- All users start fresh with their full monthly allotment on the billing renewal date
- Encourage users to plan reservations early in the month to avoid missing out

**Suggested phrasing:**
"Unused experiences don't carry over to the next month, so your allotment resets on your billing date. We recommend booking early to make the most of your plan!"

title: How to Update Account or Profile Information
content:
If a user wants to update their personal details:

- Guide them to 'My Account' > 'Profile Settings'
- Email changes require verification via a confirmation link sent to the new address
- Payment method updates are done under 'Payment Methods'
- Name and contact info changes are self-service and take effect immediately

**Suggested phrasing:**
"You can update your profile information anytime under 'Profile Settings' in 'My Account'. Note that changing your email will require verification."

title: How to Handle Events Cancelled by the Venue
content:
If an event is cancelled by the organizer or venue:

- Affected users are notified automatically via push notification and email
- The used experience credit is automatically returned to the user's monthly balance
- Offer to help the user find an alternative event in the same category
- If the user wants a refund instead of a credit (for premium paid events), escalate to support lead

**Suggested phrasing:**
"We're sorry, but this event was cancelled by the venue. Your experience credit has been automatically returned to your account, and I can help you find a similar event if you'd like."
tags: event cancellation, venue, credit refund, escalation

title: How to Add a Guest to a Reservation
content:
If a user wants to bring a guest to an event:

- Check whether the specific event allows guest reservations (visible on the event detail page)
- If allowed, guest slots typically use an additional experience credit from the user's monthly allotment
- Guests must be added at the time of booking; they cannot be added after the reservation is confirmed
- Some premium events may not support guests at all

**Suggested phrasing:**
"If the event supports guests, you can add one during booking, which will use an extra experience credit. Please note guests can't be added after the reservation is confirmed."

title: How to Report an Issue During or After an Event
content:
If a user reports a problem experienced at the venue (accessibility, safety, service quality):

- Thank them for the feedback and apologize for the inconvenience
- Collect key details: event name, date, and a description of the issue
- For safety or accessibility concerns, escalate immediately to support lead
- For general feedback, log it for the venue partnerships team; do not promise compensation without approval

**Suggested phrasing:**
"I'm sorry to hear that. Could you share the event name and date, along with what happened? I'll make sure this is escalated to the right team."
